sample: Sample payment terms shall be 100% before production. (If the order is cancelled midway for personal reasons, the payment is non-refundable.)

Samples are shipped via the fastest courier service (e.g., DHL/FedEx), excluding import duties. Please ensure your cooperation with local customs clearance and settle any applicable charges. All duties and taxes are the recipient's responsibility.
All sample specifications will be confirmed before production begins. No changes are allowed once production is arranged.
If the sample does not match the agreed specifications (as per the invoice/proof), the supplier will correct it at no extra cost.
If modifications are requested due to personal preference (e.g., color, design change), the customer will cover all additional costs.
bulk: Payment terms shall be 50% deposit before production, the balance before shipping. (If the order is cancelled midway, the deposit is non-refundable.)
It's allowed of 5-10% quantity tolerance (more or less), which will be updated before shipping.
The size will have 1-3cm difference because of handmade; the fabric may have color difference, touching feeling deviation from different batch for sample and bulk orders.

If customers fail to pay the balance one month after goods ready, warehouse fee will be charged 20USD/Day/CBM. We will consider the goods abandoned by the customers, and we can sell them to other customers without a refund of the deposit.
